A few useful answers
Before you
get in touch.
Can I request specifications or samples?
Include the product name and your requirements. Ask BPI to confirm current specifications, sample availability, terms and lead times.
Can I enquire about a custom battery?
Yes. Use the customization pages or include your electrical, mechanical and operating requirements in the enquiry.
Does this form send automatically?
No. It prepares a reviewable email draft. You choose when to open your email app and send it, or copy the text into an email yourself.
